_about: Reviewed choices for the longest river. null: the card shows no river. 'item' sets the Wikidata river. 'name' and 'km' replace the Wikidata label and length, or give a river that has no Wikidata length. '_join' gives, for a Wikidata river, the Natural Earth line names that are parts of it. '_names' replaces a Wikidata label. '_split' divides a Natural Earth line that follows two rivers.

_split.name: Paraná
_split.reason: Natural Earth draws the Paraguay River and the lower Paraná as one line. The rivers meet at 27.3° S.

BLZ.reason: The Belize River is the longest river of Belize. The Hondo has a line but is shorter.

BRN.name: Belait River
BRN.reason: Wikipedia names the Belait as the longest river of Brunei. Wikidata gives no length. The Baram flows in Malaysia.

CHL.reason: The Loa, 440 km, is the longest river of Chile. Natural Earth has no line for it.

DNK.name: Gudenå
DNK.reason: Danish Wikipedia: 149 km, the longest river of Denmark. Wikidata gives no length.

GNB.reason: The Corubal flows from Guinea into Guinea-Bissau and is longer than the Geba.

GNQ.reason: The Campo (Ntem) forms the border with Cameroon and is longer than the Benito.

JAM.reason: The Rio Minho is the longest river of Jamaica. Wikidata gives the Cabarita River a wrong length of 397 km.

JPN.reason: The Shinano is the longest river of Japan. Natural Earth has no line for it.

KGZ.reason: The Chu flows through Kyrgyzstan and is longer than the Naryn. Wikipedia gives 1,067 km. Wikidata gives 1,318 km.

LBN.reason: The Orontes rises in Lebanon and is longer than the Jordan.

MAR.reason: The Draa is the longest river of Morocco. Natural Earth has no line for it.

MKD.reason: The Vardar is the longest river of North Macedonia. Natural Earth has no line for it.

MNG.reason: The Irtysh rises in China near the border. The Kherlen is the longest river of Mongolia.

MYS.reason: The Rajang is the longest river of Malaysia. Natural Earth has no line for it.

SLE.reason: The Moa flows through Sierra Leone and is longer than the Rokel.

UKR.reason: The Danube forms the border with Romania along its Chilia branch. The Natural Earth line follows another branch.

XKX.reason: The Ibar flows through Kosovo. The Natural Earth line for the Morava touches only its border.
